extractions.original_text: Feature request for @_groww: Please add a 'Smart SIP pause during salary change' mode. Right now if a user has a career gap, they simply delete the SIP and never come back.

extractions.evidence_quote: Can Groww please introduce multi-bank mandate fallback
extractions.author: @BengaluruInvestor
extractions.original_text: Can Groww please introduce multi-bank mandate fallback? If Primary bank has low balance on SIP date, attempt debit on Secondary bank before bouncing.

extractions.evidence_quote: Why do new SIP investors drop off at month 6
extractions.author: @Shikha_Wealth
extractions.original_text: Why do new SIP investors drop off at month 6? Our analytics show 68% of cancellations happen following 2 consecutive negative monthly returns statements. Fintechs must fix beginner education.

extractions.evidence_quote: [ValuePickr Forum] Fintech Direct MF platforms vs AMC direct websites: Groww has democratized mutual funds for 20-somethings, but the key metric is 12
extractions.author: Senior Investor (ValuePickr)
extractions.original_text: [ValuePickr Forum] Fintech Direct MF platforms vs AMC direct websites: Groww has democratized mutual funds for 20-somethings, but the key metric is 12-month and 36-month SIP persistence. The drop-off rate is highest among investors whose first 6 months coincided with a sideways or negative market.

extractions.evidence_quote: [DesiDime] Groww SIP rewards: Groww used to give cashback scratch cards for setting up SIP
extractions.author: deal_master_india
extractions.original_text: [DesiDime] Groww SIP rewards: Groww used to give cashback scratch cards for setting up SIP. Many college students started 500 rs SIP just for the 50 rs reward and stopped in month 2. Good for acquisition, terrible for real 12-month retention.

extractions.evidence_quote: [Quora India] Is it safe to invest 10,000/month via SIP in Groww for 15 years
extractions.author: Certified Financial Planner (Quora)
extractions.original_text: [Quora India] Is it safe to invest 10,000/month via SIP in Groww for 15 years? Yes. Groww is registered with AMFI (ARN-111686) and BSE Star MF. Even if Groww ceases operations, all units are stored in your name with the respective AMC (HDFC, SBI, Mirae) and tracked via CAMSKRA.

extractions.evidence_quote: [DesiDime] Bank NACH mandate cancellation: Warning to first timers
extractions.author: frugal_engineer
extractions.original_text: [DesiDime] Bank NACH mandate cancellation: Warning to first timers! If you delete a SIP on Groww, also verify in your net banking that the e-mandate is revoked. Otherwise bank might still try to debit and trigger penalty if balance is zero.

extractions.original_text: [ValuePickr Forum] When BSE Star MF gateway has maintenance on weekend nights, SIP orders scheduled for Monday morning frequently get stuck in 'Processing'. Groww needs transparent system health dashboards.
